notes.title: Starcats Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

The first update to Starcats went out tonight, in which we added each of the cats names! Now you'll know who you're fighting to lead the Starcat crew as, including: 


    Patches
    Charlemagne
    Fido
    Real Cat™
    Duster
    Earhart
    Neapolitan
    Captain Bones
    Ben
    Jerry
    Cygnus
    Arcturus
 

Make sure to let us know which Starcat is your favorite!
